integrity.predicate: per-epoch signature, chain and sequence integrity of the presented records
integrity.provenance: echo of the declared stage-1 input; reported separately and never used to decide completeness

cross_epoch.note: the link connects the record chains; cross-epoch completeness is assessed only from population evidence (R3)

claim_results.polarity: every evidence obligation of src-1 due in the interval is met by exactly one record
evidence: an epoch link is not population evidence

must_not_conclude: a withheld event named, counted or dated
pr182_mapping: PR182 names no epoch-link basis; an epoch link is not a population completeness basis. Completeness is not established; C1 is not demonstrated.
